title: Extreme Heat Sends Kluckers to Hospital as Six More Riders Exit Sweltering Vuelta a España
content:
An official heat warning is in effect for Friday’s stage as crashes, illness, and extreme temperatures take out some of the Vuelta’s biggest names.
